name: Rebuke
text: Reach: 4. Damage: 1d8 (ignoring armor). 2× damage against undead or cowardly (those Frightened or behind Cover).

name: True Strike
text: Reach: 4. A target gains advantage (ignoring all sources of disadvantage) and +1 Reach on their next attack this encounter.

name: Heal
text: Reach: 1. Heal a target 1d8+KEY HP. Powerful Healing. If 5+ mana is spent, heal a negative condition as well (e.g., Blind, 1 Wound).

source.note: "Powerful Healing." is a sidebar box printed under the spell (after the Upcast line); appended to text.

name: Warding Bond
text: Concentration: 1 min. Reach: 4. Make an ally your ward: they take 2 less damage from all sources. (1/round) When they are attacked, you may be attacked for some or all of the damage instead.

source.note: The (1/round) limits the redirect, not casting the spell, so no spell limit is set.

name: Condemn
restriction: Vs enemies who have crit since you last damaged them.
text: Vs enemies who have crit since you last damaged them. Reach: 4. Damage: 30. Cannot be reduced by any means. The next attack against that enemy gains advantage.

name: Shield of Justice
text: Castable only while Defending. Creatures who attack you are Blinded (until the end of their next turn); you deal damage back to each (ignoring armor) equal to damage you take this round.

name: Vengeance
restriction: Can only target enemies who attacked a Dying ally or reduced one to 0 HP since your last turn.
text: Can only target enemies who attacked a Dying ally or reduced one to 0 HP since your last turn. Reach: 1. Damage: 1d100.

name: Sacrifice
text: Reach: 4. Reduce yourself to 0 HP and you cannot have more than 0 HP until you Safe Rest. Heal HP equal to your max HP, divided as you choose among any other creatures. Dead? You may revive a creature that has died in the past minute if you give them at least 20 HP (also healing 2 Wounds from them), provided they have not been revived with this spell before.

source.note: "Dead?" is a sidebar box printed under the spell (after the Upcast line); appended to text. Healing equals max HP, divided by choice, so no roll is encoded.

name: Celestial Legion
text:
(1/turn) Any friendly creature may use 1 of 3 charges to call upon higher powers for aid this encounter:
• Reckoning. When you attack, gain advantage (ignoring all disadvantage) and add 1d20 damage to the attack; with advantage too, if Bloodied.
• Trembling. When attacked, the enemy becomes Frightened of you until the end of their next turn. Reduce the incoming damage by 1d20 if Bloodied.

source.note: The (1/turn) limits charge use, not casting, so no spell limit is set. Charge bonuses (1d20) are not encoded as a roll.

name: Redeem
restriction: Requires (and consumes) a diamond worth 10,000 gp.
text: Requires (and consumes) a diamond worth 10,000 gp. Reach: 1 mile. Revive any number of creatures that have died in the past year, provided they have not died of old age or been revived with this spell before.

name: Light
text: Cause an item to brightly glow as a torch with radiant light for as long as you hold it.

name: Beautify
text: Clean stains or repair a small tear/break in a non-magical item, or conjure tiny beautiful things: flowers, butterflies, etc.

name: Bond of Peace
text: Bond. Telepathically communicate simple thoughts or feelings with a friendly creature you can see. OR: Peace. Imbue your spoken words with calming magic, granting advantage on any check made to soothe anger or fear in creatures who can hear you.
